annotations.title: File Once, List to All — OmniList

description: OmniList (PAID $1.00 USDC on Base via x402). File-once listing run for an x402 server or MCP server: give ONE server record and OmniList presence-checks it, files it where it is missing, and reads back a receipt at x402-list, 402index, x402dash, nohumans.directory and the MCP Registry (PREPARED artifact there — publishing needs the namespace owner's own key). Every venue is free to file; the $1.00 pays for the run, the venue know-how, and the verified per-venue report (states: FILED with receipt id, PENDING_REVIEW, ALREADY_PRESENT by read-back, PREPARED, BLOCKED with the exact reason). Runs execute live against third-party venues, so this tool starts the run and returns a run_id; fetch the finished report with omnilist_report or GET /x402/omnilist/runs/<run_id>. Use for: getting a new x402/MCP server into the directories agents actually browse. Don't use when: you expect a guaranteed listing (venue review decisions belong to the venues) or a free run (there is none — unpaid calls return the payment challenge). Settlement to the canonical SML payTo on Base.

endpoints.description: Individual payable endpoint URLs for endpoint-level venues (402index, x402dash).

mcp_endpoint.description: Remote MCP endpoint (streamable-http), when the server speaks MCP.

networks.description: Network slugs the server settles on, e.g. ["base"].

payment_header.description: Base64 X-PAYMENT EIP-3009 payload (standard rail) for $1.00 USDC on Base.

payment_tx_hash.description: Base USDC tx hash (sovereign rail) paying $1.00 to the canonical SML receiver.

registry_name.description: MCP Registry name you own, e.g. "com.example/my-server" — used for the PREPARED server.json artifact.

settler_address.description: Single settler / signer address (facilitators) — alias for a one-entry settler_addresses list.

tools.description: Tool inventory for the MCP Registry artifact: every tool name + price is declared in the generated server.json.
